mentions.name: devlens.io
mentions.description: An open source codebase visualization tool designed to make onboarding to a codebase and reviewing pull requests easier. Its standout 'blast radius' feature shows how far the effect of changing a component will propagate through the codebase.
mentions.problem: Understanding unfamiliar codebases is difficult, making onboarding and PR review hard.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building devlens.io, an open source tool for codebase visualization tool for easy onboarding and easy PR review.
